services.name: Shut-off valves, replaced and tagged
services.blurb: Stuck valves swapped for quarter-turn ones, then each shut-off hung with a numbered brass tag.

services.name: Drain clearing
services.blurb: Kitchen, tub and basement drains cleared with the right cable, and the cause explained.

services.name: Water heater repair and replacement
services.blurb: Tanks flushed, anodes checked and old heaters replaced with the venting brought up to code.

services.name: Tankless water heaters
services.blurb: Wall-hung tankless heaters sized to your showers, with a flush valve kit for hard water.

services.name: Water softeners
services.blurb: Indianapolis water is hard; a softener stops the white crust on fixtures and inside heaters.

services.name: Sewer camera inspection
services.blurb: A camera down the main line, with the video and the footage marks handed to you.

services.name: Pressure regulators
services.blurb: Pressure read at a hose bib and brought back into the normal 40 to 80 psi range.

services.name: Toilet and faucet repair
services.blurb: Running toilets, dripping faucets and loose bases fixed with parts carried on the van.

services.name: Sump pumps
services.blurb: Pumps tested with a bucket of water, check valves replaced, discharge lines run clear.

services.name: Frozen pipe repair
services.blurb: Split pipes cut out and replaced, and the cold wall that froze them insulated or rerouted.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: We bought a 1920s house in Irvington and had no idea where anything was. Dana walked the whole basement with me, replaced two stuck valves and hung a brass tag on every one. Main shut-off is tag 01.
reviews.name: Hannah G.

reviews.text: Water heater was 13 years old and rumbling. They flushed it first and told me straight it had about a year left. We replaced it in the fall on our schedule, not on a cold morning.
reviews.name: Marcus L.

reviews.text: Our shower heads were crusted white every few months. The softener went in next to the water heater, they showed us how to add salt, and the glass door finally stays clear.
reviews.name: Jen W.

reviews.text: Basement drain backed up twice in one month. The camera showed roots at 42 feet. They cleared it, gave me the video, and explained the options without pushing a dig.
reviews.name: Ray C.

reviews.text: Pressure gauge on the spigot read 96. That explained the banging pipes and the leaking toilet fill valve. New regulator in about two hours and the house is quiet now.
reviews.name: Alicia M.

reviews.text: Pipe on the garage wall froze in January. They cut out the split and moved the line inside the heated wall. Took a second visit to patch the drywall, which I'd have liked done the first time.
reviews.name: Tom E.

proof.guarantee: If a repair we made leaks within a year, we come back and fix it at no charge.
